validated_results.title: Phase 3 clinical trial investigating the effect of selenium supplementation in men at high-risk for prostate cancer.
validated_results.reason: This Phase 3 randomized controlled trial evaluates the effect of selenium supplementation versus placebo on incident prostate cancer in men with prior negative biopsy.

extraction.population: Men at high risk for prostate cancer with prior negative prostate biopsy

sample_size.excerpt: Eight hundred and seventy-five men were recruited for this trial and 699 (79.9%) subjects were randomized to receive placebo (n = 232), 200 µg/day selenium (n = 234) or 400 µg/day selenium (n = 233). Two hundred and ninety-two subjects (41.8%) completed the trial, seventy-four (10.6%) reached the study endpoint (diagnosis of biopsy proven prostate cancer) and sixty-one (8.7%) were still receiving study agent when the trial was stopped by the DSMC.

cases.excerpt: During the course of the trial, 74 subjects were diagnosed with prostate cancer despite having a prostate biopsy negative for cancer at the beginning of the study.
cases.location: Results, Recruitment and Participant Characteristics, paragraph 1

effect_size.excerpt: Compared to placebo, the hazard ratios [95% confidence intervals] for risk of developing prostate cancer in the selenium 200 µg/day or the selenium 400 µg/day group were 0.94 [0.52, 1.7] and 0.90 [0.48, 1.7] respectively.

confidence_interval.excerpt: Compared to placebo, the hazard ratios [95% confidence intervals] for risk of developing prostate cancer in the selenium 200 µg/day or the selenium 400 µg/day group were 0.94 [0.52, 1.7] and 0.90 [0.48, 1.7] respectively.

p_value.excerpt: Twenty six (11.3%), 24 (10.3%) and 23 (10%) subjects reached the study endpoint (biopsy proven prostate cancer) in the placebo, Se 200 µg/day and Se 400 µg/day treatment groups, respectively ( p =0.88).
p_value.location: Results, Effects of selenium on incidence of prostate cancer, paragraph 1

comparison.excerpt: Participants were randomized to receive daily oral placebo (N = 232), 200 µg selenium (N =234), or 400 µg selenium (N=233) as selenized yeast.

design.excerpt: A Phase 3 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial was conducted in 699 men at high risk for prostate cancer

timing.excerpt: They were followed every six months for up five years.

continent.excerpt: Subjects were recruited from urology offices at 20 sites in the United States and New Zealand

exposure_measurement.excerpt: High-selenium yeast was provided by Cypress Systems (Fresno, CA) [ 2 ]. The study agent (two doses) and matched placebo caplets were coated with titanium oxide to ensure identical appearance, weight, taste and smell.
exposure_measurement.location: Methods, Study agent and adherence, paragraph 1
